model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude -p, no tools; first run's agent could not read its file)

quantifiers: (none) -> at least some (added in the closing clause)
other: Subject changed from one specific keyboard ('This ... keyboard') to keyboards in general
'optical mechanical' dropped
Added claim that these features set the keyboards apart from others

quantifiers: making frequent searches unnecessary -> reducing the need for frequent lookups
other: 'size' of keys became 'length' of keys
'determine' became 'predict'
pairs.notes: The '4.' list marker is in both. 'size' to 'length' and 'determine' to 'predict' are close, so I left them as minor. The original's 'unnecessary' is a stronger claim than 'reducing the need'.
Faithful paraphrase. FIBA is in both. Only synonyms changed (sanción/medida, consumo/uso, gravedad/severidad).
Australia is in both. 'government business meetings' became 'official parliamentary sessions', and 'proposals' became 'new ideas'. I treated both as paraphrase.

The rewrite adds a 'we' subject, 'familiar expectations' became 'old habits', and 'time and effort' became 'patience and work'. The link between better communication and the speed-up is vaguer. I left these out as possible paraphrase.

other: 'unparalleled value' became 'exceptional balance' (different claim)
'long typing sessions' added as the context for reduced fatigue
'tailored for' became 'designed exclusively for' (exclusivity added)
'performance on par with' became 'speed matching'
pairs.notes: 'one of only a few' and 'one of just a handful' are the same strength. The negation 'without sacrificing' is kept.

quantifiers: più che possibile -> più che at (truncated)
other: The rewrite is garbled Italian/English code-mixing, not a faithful rewrite
'arti aperte' became 'open aperte' (the word 'arti' is lost)
'eccome se sapete' became 'sure se sapete', and 'insomma' became 'in' (truncated)
pairs.notes: The sense is mostly kept despite the mixed languages. 'Non è' is kept, so there is no negation flip.

other: Currency changed from dollars to pounds

'retire' became 'exit'

other: 'inclusion' became 'equity'
